title: The Mark
subtitle: Open only to the marked
description: This quest requires a stage, so the server draws it locked for a player
who does not have one -- and open for a player who does, in the same
party, at the same moment. The requirement is written `requiresStage`.
The task below is the other half of the same feature: a stage task asks
whether the player has the flag. It is measured, never handed in, so
there is no Submit button -- the moment you are marked, this quest is
Its reward waits for a claim on purpose: a quest a gate has shut should
not pay out either, so this is the claim to try while the flag is missing.
